purpose: Pin v2.3.0 integrator-facing contract conformance without changing Event POST, WebRTC DataChannel, SSE, or WebSocket runtime payload schemas.

reportingBoundary.artifactVerifierOnly: Passing verify-integrator-contract-artifact only proves bundle/schema/sample/checksum and evidence-boundary conformance.
reportingBoundary.runtimeDelivery: Runtime delivery PASS can be reported only for the runtime smoke commands that were actually executed.
reportingBoundary.clientUiRedaction: Client UI redaction PASS can be reported only after direct UI evidence or an explicit client UI verifier run is recorded.
